Name: combat_ids
_src: Adapter: combat-sim entity ids that differ from nemesis ids. The showcase's calendar challenger is id 'challenger' in all three sims (combat combatants.json, the board model), so nothing maps today; generated challengers are 'challenger_<night>'. Untracked combat ids (stray, captain) are ignored
